sources.design: Clinical practice guideline; older irritability framework retained alongside 2025 guideline
sources.population: Adhesive capsulitis assessed by pain, mobility and tissue irritability.
sources.comparator: Evidence synthesis, not one trial comparator.
sources.outcomes: Recommends functional pain-free ROM and stretching intensity matched to tissue irritability.
sources.followUp: Underlying studies vary; course may leave residual limitations.
sources.uncertainty: Irritability classification is clinical; calendar stage alone inadequate.
sources.harms: Excessive intensity not equated with a quantified tissue-damage threshold.
sources.limitations: No automatic app diagnosis or universal hold-time progression.

protocol.execution: High-irritability: pain-free passive/assisted ROM. Moderate: gentle/moderate stretching without sustained post-treatment aggravation. Low: progress stress into tissue resistance.
protocol.dose: not reported as a single universal dose.
protocol.frequency: not reported as a single universal frequency.
protocol.supervision: Clinician classifies irritability and selects interventions.
protocol.progression: Match intensity/duration to clinical irritability; no generic five-second progression.
protocol.stoppingRules: Avoid post-treatment inflammation/pain in staged framework; not a quantified autonomous stopping algorithm.

sources.design: Prospective successive temporal cohorts; not randomized despite wording about random groups
sources.population: 77 idiopathic frozen shoulders; >50% GH restriction ≥3 months.
sources.comparator: 45 supportive/pain-limited movement versus 32 intensive mobilization/stretching beyond pain threshold.
sources.coInterventions: Education/resume tolerated activities versus therapist treatment and home exercises.
sources.outcomes: Constant ≥80 at 24 months: 89% versus 63%, favoring pain-limited group.
sources.uncertainty: Temporal confounding; mechanism of inflammatory aggravation is author hypothesis.
sources.harms: No quantified exercise-injury incidence; poorer outcomes not proof every painful repetition damages tissue.
sources.limitations: Not all secondary/postoperative cases or all stages.

protocol.execution: Pain-limited pendulum and active exercises, resume tolerated activities; exact trunk support/pendulum geometry not specified.
protocol.dose: not reported for holds/reps of pendulum/active exercises.
protocol.frequency: not reported for exact home frequency.
protocol.supervision: Supportive education; comparison intensive physiotherapist-led regimen.
protocol.progression: Resume activities tolerated; no fixed progression.
protocol.stoppingRules: Supportive group instructed not to exceed pain threshold.
